1) Confirm the exact legal name to appear on POs/invoices (matching W-9).
2) Remittance address (if different from registered address).
3) Primary invoice email and secondary (for EDI/email fallbacks).
4) EFT/ACH details (we have the confirmation but need bank account holder name to match legal name).
5) Tax classification (e.g., US C Corp) and state tax registration if applicable.
6) Authorized signer name/email for contractual SOWs and for PO acceptance.
7) Any vendor-specific PO terms (net30, net45, special references).

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx — please fill the rows that correspond to legal/ERP mapping and upload to the Drive link below or reply with the spreadsheet. Once we have that, Marissa in AP will ingest into our ERP and assign a vendor code. Typical SLAs: 3 business days for validation, then PO-capable within 1 day after vendor code assignment.
